Container.Name: CNGI-Core
Container.Overview: CNGI Core CRM and business platform. Production runs from the published GHCR image and updates through the normal Unraid Docker update workflow.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL and Authentik connectivity for full application functionality.

Config.Name: Application Port
Config.Description: Internal application listen port. Normally leave at 8189.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string for the canonical cngi_core database.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Random secret used to sign CNGI Core browser sessions.

Config.Name: Embedded Time & HR
Config.Description: Enable Time Clock and HR inside Core after validation. Default off during parallel testing.

Config.Name: Time Database URL
Config.Description: Existing Time least-privilege PostgreSQL DSN, pointing at the SAME cngi_core database. Blank uses Core DATABASE_URL if privileges suffice.

Config.Name: Calendar Encryption Key
Config.Description: Existing Time session/encryption key, to decrypt historical Google Calendar credentials; keep unchanged.

Config.Name: Google OAuth Redirect
Config.Description: Optional new Core-host Google Calendar callback URI, also update OAuth provider authorization.

Config.Name: Authentik Employee Sync Token
Config.Description: One-way employee sync API token previously configured in Time; needed if Core becomes the sole identity sync worker.

Config.Name: Authentik Issuer Override
Config.Description: Optional issuer override for Time employee-sync API; defaults to Core Authentik OIDC provider.

Config.Name: Enable Embedded Time Workers
Config.Description: KEEP FALSE while CNGI-Time-Access Docker still runs. Enable only after stopping its calendar and Authentik sync workers.

Config.Name: Tower Backup Mount
Config.Description: Remote Tower backup location for Core. A mount alone is not an automatic backup runner; verify backups before production updates.
